usage: snapback2 test [--project dir] [--blocked reason] [--journeys-only|--derived-only|--journey name] [--json]

Prove the project and write a receipt. --journey selects an exact authored name,
runs only its matching journeys, and records scope.journey. It does not infer
affected coverage. Use plain test for the full suite. Read snapback2 guide testing.
